title: Miami, Florida, USA — 1-Bed Apartment With Bay Views & Resort Pool
description:
High in a tower at the centre of Miami Worldcenter, this **one-bedroom residence** looks out across the bay through floor-to-ceiling glass. The layout is open and light all day, and the building does the rest — this is a home you arrive at with a suitcase and nothing else.

Downstairs, and it is a long way downstairs, sits **over 70,000 sq ft of amenities**: a **resort-style pool with private cabanas**, a **hammam spa** with sauna and steam rooms, yoga and fitness studios, and on-site fine dining. There is **beach club access on Miami Beach with a shuttle**, which is the piece most city apartments cannot offer. Downtown Miami, the Arsht Center and the Design District are all within a few minutes.

The residence is delivered newly finished and furnished by design partners featured in Architectural Digest, with furniture, lighting, appliances, linens and the rest included in the purchase price. **Short-term rentals are permitted here** — the operator runs the letting and you keep the income from the nights you do not use, which is rare in American co-ownership and worth more than it sounds.

Ownership works a little differently from most homes on this site. The residence is divided into **eight shares**, and each share carries its own fixed calendar — **three two-week stays a year**, settled when you buy, one each in the shoulder, summer and winter seasons. You know your dates for the year ahead rather than competing for them, and owners can swap days with each other through the owner app. Shares are priced by the calendar they carry, so the figure above is the entry price and the exact dates are confirmed before you commit.

title: Riviera Beach, Florida, USA — 2-Bed Beachfront Residence With Private Beach
amenities: Private Beach With Chair & Umbrella Service
description:
On Singer Island, in a beachfront tower run by one of the world's great five-star hospitality names, this **1,725 sq ft residence** opens through a **private elevator foyer** onto a **wraparound terrace** with water on both sides — the Atlantic one way, the Intracoastal the other. Two bedrooms plus a flex room, two and a half baths, and the quiet that comes with being north of the crowds.

What you are really buying is the service. A **private beach with chair and umbrella service**, **two resort-style pools** with whirlpool spas and poolside dining, a tennis court, a fitness centre, a screening room, and **24-hour concierge and valet**. It is residential living with a hotel underneath it. The Palm Beaches spread out from here — Worth Avenue, the Norton Museum, 145 golf courses across the county, and the polo and equestrian season in Wellington from January through April.

The residence has been completely reimagined by design partners featured in Architectural Digest and is delivered newly finished and furnished, included in the purchase price. **Renting is permitted here under a grandfathered right that this building holds and most five-star properties do not** — the operator runs the letting and the owner keeps the income from unused nights. It is the reason this home is worth a longer look than its price alone suggests.

Ownership works a little differently from most homes on this site. The residence is divided into **eight shares**, and each share carries its own fixed calendar — **three two-week stays a year**, settled when you buy, one each in the shoulder, summer and winter seasons, with the winter block covering dates like Art Basel, Thanksgiving, Christmas or New Year depending on the share. Owners can swap days with each other through the owner app. Shares are priced by the calendar they carry, so the figure above is the entry price and the exact dates are confirmed before you commit.

title: Snowmass Village, Colorado, USA — 2-Bed Ski-In Ski-Out Apartment With Spa
description:

Two bedrooms, two baths, natural wood throughout, a **master with its own fireplace**, and an **oversized balcony** looking down the mountain. In summer the same balcony looks over wildflower trails.

The building is a five-star operation: a **heated outdoor pool** you can sit in while it snows, a **full-service spa and fitness centre**, and fine dining without leaving the property. Aspen Snowmass means four mountains — Snowmass itself, Aspen Mountain in town, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk — and a calendar that does not stop when the snow does: Wintersköl in December, the X Games, the Aspen Music Festival and Art Week in summer, fly fishing and gold aspens through the autumn.

The residence is delivered newly finished and furnished by design partners featured in Architectural Digest, with furniture, lighting, appliances and hospitality supplies included in the purchase price. **Short-term rentals are permitted** — the operator handles the letting and the owner keeps the income from their unused nights, which in a ski market with this kind of demand is not a small line.
